svg.title: Known-best packing of 157 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=157 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 2026-11-11 rational centre-basis witness at 157, read exactly from the retained source file without its schema envelope, in the watched repository JoostdeWinter/square-packing, which jlevy/squares#958 names: a pinwheel the source derives from Samanyu-dev's public 109-square packing, by two cut-and-fill steps, the first giving its packing of 132. Finite construction feasibility only; the 250-digit contact solution, local optimum, KKT, rigidity, same-packing, novelty, priority and global optimality are not replayed here.

svg.text: U n=157 known best: side ~ 12.99330261 (certified upper bound)
